Companion Animal Travel Desk guide for traveling with pets

This article explains how Aurelia Skyways supports travelers who fly with companion animals, what to prepare before departure, and how to use the Companion Animal Travel Desk with confidence. Our aim is to make each step clear and calm for both you and your pet.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps confirm travel eligibility, review required documents, and coordinate arrangements that support safe transport. Travelers should gather their pet's identification, health records, and any carrier details before arriving at the airport. If your plans include a transfer or a special care request, share that information early so the team can help you avoid delays.

When you arrive, the staff will review your booking and guide you through the next steps in a steady order. <<FACT F019>> Please keep your pet secured in the approved carrier or under the guidance of staff at all times in public areas. If your journey includes a waiting period, follow the directions given by the desk so that your pet remains comfortable and supervised.

Some pets may need a brief stay in a quarantine room or other controlled space before boarding or during a connection. <<FACT F028>> In these cases, the desk will explain what items are permitted, how to label belongings, and how to prepare your pet for the handoff. Bring only the items you are allowed to carry, and keep food, water, and comfort needs in mind as instructed by the team.

If you are traveling with more than one pet, or if your animal has medication or a behavioral support need, let the desk know as early as possible. Clear communication helps the staff arrange a smoother experience and reduces stress for you and your companion. The same guidance applies whether you are traveling alone or with family members.

For additional help, contact the Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure or speak with the airport staff on the day of travel.
